research_status: New exploratory models on previously examined historical outcomes; not preregistered confirmation or temporal validation.
guardrails: Current verified classifications describe a retrospective cross-section; they do not reconstruct historical point-in-time classifications or support trading backtests.
No historical hypothesis is re-estimated or reclassified; H1-H4/H8 remain separate and their frozen designs unchanged.
Model-implied geometric mean capitalization is not spot fair value or a price target; no share-supply conversion.
Residuals measure relative model fit, not proven mispricing or actionable alpha.
Chain and application fee scopes differ; peer multiples require identical observed scope and verified holder capture for holder denominators.
No p-values or confirmatory hypothesis claims; all model comparisons and sample exclusions are disclosed.
uncertainty: For each outer held-out asset, refit after omitting each remaining training asset. The 90th percentile absolute inner held-out errors defines a symmetric empirical log-error band around the outer prediction. This is a diagnostic band, without calibrated or guaranteed prediction coverage.
